affiliations.date_precision: The official Army register records promotion to lieutenant colonel of Infantry on June 12, 1939. It records continued Army service but does not identify the OSS transfer date or prove that Infantry was the immediate predecessor assignment.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact restricted officer identifier resolves the person. The 1939 Infantry role is a documented prewar military assignment, not a civilian employer and not a proven immediate pre-OSS affiliation.

affiliations.research_notes: The broad historical occupation category is preserved without choosing one trade or inventing an employer, workplace, union, business, or employment relationship.

claims.temporal_assessment: The Army records document service before and during World War II but do not state the date or terms of OSS assignment.
claims.match_notes: The restricted officer identifier is withheld. The full middle name is added as a documented variant, not as a silent correction to the index.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index and the official Army register agree on Stuart R. Carswell's uncommon name and exact restricted officer identifier. The register documents his Infantry career and 1939 lieutenant-colonel promotion; the contemporary Congressional Record supplies the full middle name Randall.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 110 for Carswell's immediate Army-to-OSS assignment sequence and last civilian employer before his long Army career. The 1939 Infantry role is documented but is not labeled immediate pre-OSS.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies Miro Cartelli in Box 110 without rank or restricted identifier. The official Army file has no exact-name row, and official, CIA, Library of Congress, exact-name OSS, employment, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches produced no defensible identity bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 110 for name spelling, nationality, birth year, identifiers, personnel status, employer, occupation, and pre-OSS chronology. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index and official Army bulk record share Albert W. Carter's exact restricted identifier. The Army record documents entry as a private on November 23, 1940. Its damaged name-field character is not adopted as a variant, and residual occupation value 999 is left uninterpreted.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 110 for Albert W. Carter's civilian occupation, named employer, exact Army assignment, and Army-to-OSS chronology. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies Bernard S. Carter in Box 110 without rank or restricted identifier. Other Bernard S. Carter candidates remain possible.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 110 for identifiers, full middle name, birth data, and wartime assignments before testing the Bernard Shirley Carter banker-and-officer candidate. Do not attach Morgan employment or Army service from name agreement alone.
